page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-64-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs built on the arm64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

For storage-intensive operations, this instance incorporates local NVMe SSD storage, as indicated by its 14 local SSD configuration, though specific local storage capacity metrics are not defined. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses and features zero GPUs, focusing entirely on CPU-driven memory and storage workloads.

The arm64 architecture combined with a high-density memory configuration provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large memory footprints without the overhead of x86 licensing. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, large-scale caching layers, and enterprise workloads that benefit from dedicated arm64 processing cores and local NVMe SSD performance.
